releases.notes:
# ✨ **LotteryMod v1.2 Changelog** ✨  

## 🏆 **New Features & Improvements**  

### 🔹 **Configurable Currency** 💰  
- You can now customize the currency item used for ticket purchases and payouts!  
- Whether it’s diamonds, emeralds, or any other item, configure it easily in the settings.  

### 🔹 **Enhanced Winner Announcement 🎆**  
- Winners now get a **full-screen title message** in addition to the chat announcement!  
- Their victory is impossible to miss.  

### 🔹 **Fireworks Overhaul 🚀**  
- We’ve upgraded the fireworks display to **fast-burst explosions** with a synchronized **victory jingle** 🎵, making the celebration much more exciting!  

### 🔹 **Cleaned-Up Command Outputs 📢**  
- Lottery info now displays the configured currency in a **clean, readable format** (no more debug clutter).  

### 🔹 **Tweaked Default Configurations ⚙️**  
- Default values have been adjusted for a more **server-friendly setup**, ensuring better balance and usability.  

### 🔹 **Open-Source Release! 🛠️**  
- LotteryMod is now **fully open-source** on GitHub! 🎉  
- Developers can contribute, customize, and improve the mod together.  

---

## 🐞 **Bug Fixes & Performance Enhancements**  

✔️ **Fixed various crashes** related to invalid currency configurations.  
✔️ **Improved registry lookups** to prevent compatibility issues with NeoForge.  
✔️ **Optimized backend processes** for better server performance.  

---

🚀 **Upgrade now to LotteryMod v1.2 and bring more excitement to your NeoForge server!** 🎟️
